t: Dine chatzer pachot mearba ammot ubib
s: Dine chatzer pachot mearba ammot ubib ubo ch' seipim: chatzer shehi pechuta mid' ammot al d' ammot usemuka lirshut harabbim, en shopekin letokah mayim beshabbat bimot hachamma, shekkevan sheen bah d' ammot, en satayim mayim sheadam ragil lehishtammesh bekol yom reuyim libbala bah, vahare zeh keillu shopekan lirshut harabbim. Veap al pi sheen bishpika zo shemmechatzer lirshut harabbim issur shel tora (im eno shopekan samuk lirshut harabbim mammash ella berachoq meat, beinyan sheyyetziatan lirshut harabbim hi mealehen, veenenna koach shepikato mammash ella kocho hu gorem bilbad), umikkol maqom middibre soperim asur (bekol inyan), gezera shemma yishpekennu lirshut harabbim (o bechatzer samuk lirshut harabbim) mammash. Lekak tzarik laasot guma shettehe chalalah machazeqet satayim, sheyyukelo mi tashmisho lered letokah, velo yihyeh keillu shopekan lirshut harabbim — ben im yaasenna bechatzer ben im yaasenna birshut harabbim samuk lechatzer mammash. Ella sheim yaasenna bachutz, tzarik lekassot binsarim, sheim tehe megulla — peamim sheyyihyeh repesh vetit betokah velo tehe amuqqa asara, vetihyeh karmelit. Abal keshehi mekussa upiha lirshut hayyachid, hare zeh chore reshut hayyachid shehem kirshut hayyachid:

Vekevan sheyyaaseh guma satayim, muttar lishpok bah ubechatzer kol mah sheyyirtzeh — apillu kor vaapillu korayim, vaapillu nitmallea hagguma meereb shabbat, dekevan shettiqqenu lo chakamim zeker leshabbat shello yishkach veyishpekem birshut harabbim hu beatzmo, shub en lachush im hem yotzeim mealehem lirshut harabbim (raq sheyyizzaher shello yishpekem samuk lirshut harabbim mammash shello etzel hagguma, beinyan sheyyetziatan lirshut harabbim hi koach shepikato mammash, sheyyesh bezeh issur shel tora, kemo bimgalgel chepetz mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim). Abal im enah machazeqet satayim, lo yishpok bah apillu meat, gezera shemma yishpok harbeh yoter mimmah shehi machazeqet:

Vekol zeh bimot hachamma, sheadam maqpid al likluk chatzero vechapetz hu sheyyetzeu hammayim mimmenna lachutz, ukeshehem yotzeim hare nitqayyema machashabto, veyesh ligzor shemma yishpekem beatzmo hachutza. Abal bimot haggeshamim, sheen adam maqpid al likluk chatzero veeno mitkavven sheyyetzeu hammayim mimmenna lachutz, en lachush lekak, umuttar lishpok bah kol mah sheyyirtzeh apillu hi qetanna meod (vaapillu shopekan samuk lirshut harabbim mammash, im hu beinyan sheeno "pesiq resheh" sheyyetzeu lirshut harabbim miyyad mikkoach shepikato mammash):

Velamma en chosheshim lemarit haayin, sheharoeh shehatztzinnor shebbeqarqaut chatzero meqalleach mayim beshabbat yomar shehu atzmo shepakan lirshut harabbim (o bechatzer samuk mammash litziatan lirshut harabbim, bemitkavven kede sheyyetzeu lirshut harabbim)? Lepi shebbimot haggeshamim setam tzinnorot meqallechim hem me geshamim, veyomar haroeh shemme geshamim hem. Vaapillu shello bishat haggeshem, yomru me geshamim hem shemmitmatztzim veholekim min haggeshamim sheaberu:

Veim yesh bechatzer d' al d', apillu enah merubbaat ella arukka uqetzara, kegon sheorkah shemoneh ammot verochbah b' — muttar lishpok bah kol mah sheyyirtzeh apillu bimot hachamma, mippene shehassatayim sheadam ragil lehishtammesh bekol yom en ligzor bahem bechatzer zo shehare reuyim libbala bah, veim ken kesheshshopekan eno shopekan kede sheyyetzeu lachutz. Veap im era sheyyotzein, en kavvanato lekak, velo nitqayyema machashabto bitzia zo, veen ligzor bah shemma yishpekem hu atzmo birshut harabbim. Lepikak ap im rotzeh lehishtammesh bah yoter missatayim — lo gazeru, sheddabar sheeno matzuy hu. Veken ap im hi melea mayim meereb shabbat, shezzehu gam ken dabar sheeno matzuy, velo ratzu ligzor bishbil zeh bilbad, kevan shebbesatayim shergilim lehibbala bah en ligzor bahem (umikkol maqom tzarik lizzaher shello lishpok samuk lirshut harabbim mammash kemo shennitbaer):

Vechatzer veaksadra sheen bekol achat mehen lebaddah d' ammot, ella behitztorput shettehen — hare ellu mitztorpot led' ammot lehattir lishpok bahen. Vehu haddin shette deyutaot shellipne b' aliyyot vaalehen maaziba rabba sheruyim hammayim libbala bah, veen bekol achat mehen lebaddah d' ammot — mitztorpot zo im zo im hen semukot zo lezo betok d' tepachim, shettashmishan noach mizzo lezo vahare hen kidyuta achat:

Vekol zeh bechatzer hassemuka lirshut harabbim. Abal hassemuka lekarmelit, apillu hi qetanna meod — en tzarik guma, umuttar lishpok bah kol mah sheyyirtzeh apillu bimot hachamma, ap al pi shemmitkavven sheyyetzeu lachutz, shekkevan sheeno shopekan beyadayv lekarmelit o samuk lekarmelit mammash, ella mikkocho hem baim lekarmelit, vekocho bekarmelit lo gazeru, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq kan ben reshut harabbim lekarmelit, velo ameru shekkocho bekarmelit lo gazeru ella beyammim uneharot sheenam mitchallepim birshut harabbim, o apillu karmelit shebbayyabbasha ella shehi chutz lair, sheggam ken enah mitchallepet birshut harabbim gemura, sheen derek lihyot rabbim metzuyim kol kak chutz lair keshiur beqiat harabbim birshut harabbim gemura, abal karmelit shebbetok hair mitchallepet birshut harabbim gemura. Vaapillu bizman hazzeh sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim gemura mippene sheen shishshim ribbo boqeim bah, mikkol maqom mitchallepet hi beir gedola sheyyesh bah s' ribbo. Umah shehittiru bigzuzetra sheal pi hammayim lishpok derek hanneqeb, ap al pi shehashshopakin holekin mikkocho lehalea mikkeneged mechitztzat haggezuzetra kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h, hu mishshum sheeno mitkavven lekak, kemo shennitbaer sham. Abal kan kesheshshopek lechatzer sheen bah d' ammot bimot hachamma mitkavven sheyyetzeu lachutz mishshum likluk chatzero. Veken iqqar. Uledibre hakkol bechatzer sheenah meorebet lo gazeru al kocho, umuttar lishpok bechatzer zo bemitkavven sheyyetzeu mimmenna lechatzer zo ap al pi shello erebu yachad. Veir hammuqqepet choma velo erebu bah, kechatzer sheenah meorebet hi, kevan sheyyesh lah mechitztzot ella shemmechusseret erub:

Bib, vehu charitz heasuy leqalleach shopakin shebbechatzer lirshut harabbim umoshek veholek bemeshek reshut harabbim harbeh, im hu mekusseh birshut harabbim d' ammot hassemukim lechatzer, veyesh berochbo gam ken d' ammot — muttar lishpok apillu al pi habbib shebbechatzer samuk mammash lirshut harabbim, apillu bimot hachamma, ap al pi shehammayim yotzeim miyyad miyyado lirshut harabbim lechutz mid' ammot hammekussim, mippene shed' al d' ellu shel bib hammekussim birshut harabbim, shehem kechore reshut hayyachid, dinam kechatzer sheyyesh bah d' al d' shemmuttar lishpok bah apillu bimot hachamma, lepi shebbed' al d' shel bib rauy gam ken libbala satayim kemo bechatzer. Ubilbad shello yehe sillon shel etz sheen hammayim reuyim libbala bo. Abal im asuy keen ritzpa shel abanim, rauy libbala bo umuttar. Vekol zeh lirshut harabbim. Abal lekarmelit — apillu besillon shel etz muttar lepi sebara harishona. Veap sheen zeh iqqar, mikkol maqom yesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel betzinnor hamqalleach lemala mi' bekarmelit, shemmuttar lishpok bo apillu bemitkavven sheyyeredu hammayim lekarmelit, kevan shehem oberim derek avir meqom petur, sheyyesh mattirim bezeh bekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v:
